# IPC — D-Bus control plane

- Owner: `ticonnect-core`
- Stage: 2
- Layer: `domain`
- Component graph: [generated/components/ipc.md](generated/components/ipc.md)

## Purpose

Define one stable D-Bus contract, DTOs, error names, dispatch, signals, client proxies, and compatibility versioning.

## Boundary

Depends on core DTO types. Daemon implements the service. UI, overlay, tray, and CLI use client proxies. No daemon internals.

## Owned state

- D-Bus interface version

## Invariants

- `INV-STAGE-1` — Every stage demo uses only components from that stage or earlier stages. Test: cargo xtask systems --check

## Failure semantics

- unknown callers are rejected by session bus defaults
- daemon absence returns typed client errors
- signal payloads are versioned

## Open decisions

- interface version negotiation
